title: The Telling the Truth about Being Nervous
youtube_title: The Telling the Truth about Being Nervous | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Vera feels shy about saying 'I feel nervous' without making a joke of it. Instead of pretending not to care, Vera tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
